# ✈️ ADPS

## Airline Disruption & Recovery Planning System

ADPS is a prototype system for synthetic airline disruption and recovery scenario analysis.

## Features

- Disruption scenario simulation
- Recovery strategy recommendation
- Composite score
- Estimated cost
- Protected passenger estimate
- Delay exposure estimate
- Scenario history
- Scenario analytics
- REST API
- Web dashboard

## Important Notice

This project uses synthetic illustrative scenario data.

It is not connected to real airline operational systems and must not be treated as an operational airline decision-making system.
